name: Neck Rolls
description: Gentle neck mobility for a short movement break.
steps: Sit or stand tall with shoulders relaxed.
Draw a small slow circle with your head.
Reverse direction and keep the movement controlled.

name: Shoulder Circles
description: Simple shoulder mobility for desk or standing breaks.
steps: Stand or sit tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Roll both shoulders forward in smooth circles.
Switch direction and keep your breathing easy.

name: Standing Thoracic Rotations
description: Upper-body rotation drill for quick mobility sessions.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms crossed lightly.
Rotate your chest to one side without forcing range.
Return to center and alternate sides at a steady pace.

name: Standing Cat-Cow
description: Equipment-free spine mobility without floor contact.
steps: Place hands on thighs with knees softly bent.
Round your back gently and tuck your chin.
Lift your chest and lengthen through the spine.

name: Hip Circles
description: Controlled hip mobility for small indoor spaces.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Place hands on hips and draw slow circles.
Reverse direction while keeping the movement smooth.

name: Ankle Rocks
description: Short ankle mobility sequence for standing breaks.
steps: Stand near a wall or chair if you want balance support.
Rock gently from heels to toes.
Circle each ankle slowly before switching sides.

name: Wrist Mobility
description: Quick wrist and hand mobility for screen breaks.
steps: Extend both arms forward with relaxed shoulders.
Make slow wrist circles in one direction.
Reverse direction and gently open and close your hands.

name: Standing Side Bends
description: Side-body mobility that fits in a compact room.
steps: Stand tall with feet grounded.
Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the opposite side.
Return to center and alternate sides with control.

name: Hamstring Sweeps
description: Low-impact posterior-chain mobility for micro-sessions.
steps: Step one heel slightly forward with toes lifted.
Hinge at the hips and sweep both hands toward the toes.
Stand back up and alternate legs at an easy pace.

name: Seated Spinal Twist
description: Chair-friendly rotation drill for short mobility breaks.
steps: Sit tall with feet flat on the floor.
Turn your chest gently toward one side.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

name: Brisk March In Place
description: Low-impact cardio for a quick indoor energy lift.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
March in place while lifting knees comfortably.
Swing your arms naturally and keep a steady pace.

name: Step Jacks
description: No-jump cardio variation for small spaces.
steps: Stand with feet together and arms by your sides.
Step one foot out while raising both arms overhead.
Step back in and alternate sides at a lively pace.

name: Low-Impact Skaters
description: Side-to-side cardio without jumping.
steps: Stand with knees softly bent.
Step diagonally behind with one foot while reaching across.
Alternate sides and keep the movement light.

name: Forward Toe Taps
description: Compact cardio drill with a steady rhythm.
steps: Stand tall with arms relaxed.
Tap one toe forward and return it under your hips.
Alternate feet and add arm swings as the pace increases.

name: Quick Side Steps
description: Room-friendly cardio using short lateral steps.
steps: Stand with feet under hips and knees soft.
Step two counts to one side.
Step back the other way and keep your torso tall.

name: Shadow Boxing
description: Equipment-free cardio with controlled punches.
steps: Stand with feet staggered and hands near your chest.
Punch forward lightly, alternating arms.
Keep elbows soft and move your feet gently.

name: Standing Knee Lifts
description: Simple cardio sequence using controlled knee drives.
steps: Stand tall with hands relaxed or lightly in front.
Lift one knee toward waist height as comfortable.
Lower it and alternate sides with a steady rhythm.

name: Standing Mountain Climbers
description: Upright cardio option without floor contact.
steps: Stand tall and extend both arms forward.
Drive one knee up while pulling the opposite elbow back.
Alternate sides and keep the pace controlled.

name: Squat to Reach
description: Short full-body cardio using shallow squats.
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than hips.
Sit into a comfortable shallow squat.
Stand and reach both arms overhead before repeating.

name: Fast Feet
description: Higher-tempo cardio drill for short indoor bursts.
steps: Stand with knees bent and feet under hips.
Take quick light steps in place.
Keep your chest lifted and slow down whenever needed.

name: Box Breathing
description: Structured breathing drill with equal phases.
steps: Inhale through the nose for four counts.
Pause gently for four counts.
Exhale for four counts and pause again for four counts.

name: 4-6 Breathing
description: Paced breathing with a longer exhale.
steps: Sit or stand comfortably with relaxed shoulders.
Inhale through the nose for four counts.
Exhale slowly for six counts and repeat.

name: Paced Nasal Breathing
description: Quiet nasal breathing practice for a short reset.
steps: Close your mouth gently and breathe through the nose.
Match each inhale and exhale to a comfortable count.
Keep the pace smooth without straining.

name: Physiological Sigh
description: Short breathing pattern using two inhales and one exhale.
steps: Take a comfortable inhale through the nose.
Add a small second inhale at the top.
Exhale slowly through the mouth and repeat calmly.

name: Equal Breathing
description: Simple inhale and exhale rhythm for micro-sessions.
steps: Choose a comfortable count such as four.
Inhale for that count without lifting the shoulders.
Exhale for the same count and continue evenly.

name: Extended Exhale
description: Low-effort breathing drill with a longer release.
steps: Inhale naturally through the nose.
Exhale slightly longer than the inhale.
Let each breath stay quiet and unforced.

name: Belly Breathing
description: Foundational breathing practice with relaxed posture.
steps: Place one hand on your belly if comfortable.
Inhale and let the belly expand gently.
Exhale and let the belly settle back naturally.

name: Shoulder-Drop Breathing
description: Breathing drill paired with gentle shoulder release.
steps: Inhale and let the shoulders rise slightly.
Exhale and let the shoulders drop with control.
Repeat at an easy pace without forcing range.

name: Triangle Breathing
description: Three-part breathing rhythm for short guided sessions.
steps: Inhale for three or four counts.
Pause gently for the same count.
Exhale for the same count and repeat.

name: Reset Breath Scan
description: Short breathing sequence with attention to posture.
steps: Stand or sit comfortably and notice your posture.
Take three slow breaths at a natural pace.
Relax the jaw, hands, and shoulders as you continue.
